case.title: Unexpected modifications to protected configuration files on fileserver-02
case.desc: Changes detected in /etc/pam.d/ and /etc/ssh/sshd_config outside scheduled change control window.

organization.name: Kumaraguru College of Technology
organization.address: Athipalayam Road, Chinnavedampatti, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641049
organization.dpo_title: Data Protection Officer & Head of IT

steps.title: Identify changed protected files
steps.notes: Verified that /etc/ssh/sshd_config differed from the baseline hash.

steps.title: Preserve file hashes and system logs
steps.notes: Diff captured showing unauthorized PermitRootLogin edit.

steps.title: Review change against approved configuration
steps.notes: Confirmed change was initiated by an unscheduled staging deployment script.

steps.title: Restore approved file state
steps.command_executed: sudo cp /etc/ssh/sshd_config.orig /etc/ssh/sshd_config && sudo systemctl reload sshd
steps.notes: Approved configuration restored and service reloaded.

steps.title: Close incident and record in audit log
steps.command_executed: ZeroDashboard UI -> Click 'Generate Statutory Report Package'
steps.notes: Incident closed. No personal data was accessed or compromised.

recommendations: Lock down SSH configuration using immutable file attributes (chattr +i).
Mandate CI/CD approval for all server configuration updates.
Maintain Wazuh FIM real-time monitoring on /etc.
